title: TQQQ Rises 3.68% in 24 Hours but Stays Below Its 50-Day Average
text:
TQQQ Rises 3.68% in 24 Hours but Stays Below Its 50-Day Average | TokenPost 
 Advertisement Thursday, November 19, 2026 Sections Sign in News Markets Feed Data Research Home Investing 1 min read Add as a preferred source on Google TQQQ Rises 3.68% in 24 Hours but Stays Below Its 50-Day Average
 The ETF reached $55.74 in a Nov. 19 snapshot, above its seven-day average but below its 20-day and 50-day averages.
 By Enna Lee Published Nov 19, 2026, 12:22 PM EST Save Share A rising chart line stops beneath a taller metal marker / TokenPost.ai ProShares UltraPro QQQ ETF (TQQQ) rose 3.68% over 24 hours to $55.74 in a Nov. 19 snapshot, but remained below its 50-day average, leaving the broader trend under pressure.
 The price was above the seven-day average of $55.28 and just below the 20-day average of $56.92. Its 50-day average was $67.33. Reported volume was 0.44 times the five-day average.
 Momentum readings were mixed. The relative strength index was 43.43, while the moving average convergence-divergence reading was negative at -3.2686. TQQQ also traded below the Bollinger middle band, at $56.92.
 The technical levels were $57.43 and $59.13 for resistance, and $52.53 and $49.33 for support.
